name: Oculus
author: Andrew Gilley
description: Inspect, open, or track the GitHub/Codeberg project, user, or item on your clipboard with oculus.nvim, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Copy a GitHub/Codeberg URL, open the panel: inspect PRs, issues and commits, open project or user feeds, add them to the oculus.nvim tracking file.

schema.label: Tracking file
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/oculus/tracking.json; must match oculus.nvim's tracking_file.
